messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Metformin rarely causes hypoglycemia (low blood sugar) by itself. However, hypoglycemia can happen if you do not eat enough, if you drink alcohol, or if you take other medicines to lower blood sugar.
Serious side effects:
Get emergency medical help if you have signs of an allergic reaction to metformin: hives; difficult breathing; swelling of your face, lips, tongue, or throat.
This medicine can rarely cause patients to develop lactic acidosis, which can be fatal. See the “Warnings - Boxed Warning” for more details.
Call your doctor at once if you have signs of liver problems, such as upper stomach pain, loss of appetite, dark urine, clay-colored stools, or yellowing of your skin or eyes (jaundice).

The relation 'has symptom' in the triplet is defined as 'The condition or entity specified by the subject entity is characterized by the symptom specified by the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'has side effect': The subject drug may cause the adverse effect or symptom specified by the object entity.
B. 'has overdose symptom': An overdose of the subject drug may cause the symptom specified by the object entity.
C. 'treats': The subject drug is used to treat or manage the disease or medical condition specified by the object entity.
D. 'requires monitoring of': Patients taking the subject drug may need the medical test or monitoring specified by the object entity.
E. 'use with caution in': The subject drug may be unsafe or require medical supervision for patients who have the condition or characteristic specified by the object entity.
